title: Preons, braid topology, and representations of fundamental particles
note: arXiv:2501.03260v1 [physics.gen-ph], 3 Jan 2025. No journal reference on page 1. Ingested 2026-11-22 as library/arxiv-2501.03260v1/ from an owner chat upload. Maps helon states to the SU(3)_c x U(1)_em weight lattice, recovers Lambek's 4-vector model, introduces a 5-vector representation, reads chirality through B_3 -> PSL(2,Z), and proposes colour-matched braid multiplication for composites. HUMAN-REVIEW: unreviewed.
